details.updated:
def auth_user(info):
    username = info.get("username", "")
    if not username: raise ValueError("username required")
    ts = str(int(time.time()))
    msg = f"{username}:{ts}".encode()
    token = hmac.new(INTERNAL_AUTH.encode(), msg, digestmod=hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f"{token}:{ts}"
details.fix_explanation: Weak MD5-based token generation replaced with HMAC-SHA256 and timestamping to provide better cryptographic strength and less predictability. Severity: High.

def export_data(name):
    if not name or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+", name): name = "export"
    zip_name = f"{name}.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_name, "w") as zf: zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=os.path.basename(DB_FILE))
    return zip_name
details.fix_explanation: Command injection vulnerability mitigated by removing shell invocation and using Python's zipfile to create archives, plus sanitizing the provided name. Severity: Critical.
